test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper gained 7% more by selling an article for ₹580 as compared to selling it for ₹545. Find the cost price of the article.
solution:
**Concept:**

The gain percentage of the seller is due to the difference in the selling price of the article.

**Calculation:**

Difference in the selling price of the article = ₹580 - ₹545 = ₹35

According to the question-

⇒ 7over100 × CP = ₹35

⇒ CP = ₹500

**The cost price of the article is Rs 500.**
